title.narrative: Procurement Support to Emergency Resilient Agriculture for Food Security Project PARSA in Haiti

description.narrative: The World Bank funded Emergency Resilient Agriculture for Food Security Project PARSA in Haiti aims to support project beneficiaries’ access to nutritious food and increase climate- and nutrition-smart agricultural production, including in earthquake-affected areas. UNOPS supports the project through the procurement of motorized vehicles.
